title: The Nvidia Shield TV Is 7 Years Old. It Just Got a $100 Price Hike
summary: Nvidia has just announced that the Shield TV Pro is getting $100 more expensive, effective immediately. The non-Pro Shield has since been discontinued, but the Shield TV Pro lives on at the new $299.99 price.
